title: Manage Application and Tenant Databases in a Multitenant Deployment

facts.text: Application database stores application and system information required by all tenants in a multitenant deployment.
Create application database using New-NAVApplicationDatabase cmdlet or export application objects from existing database.
Enable Multitenant setting and configure database connection settings on server instance.
Publish system symbols and extensions before mounting tenants.
Create empty database in SQL Server with desired collation.
Mount database as tenant and synchronize with application database.
Synchronize and install extensions for each tenant.
Tenant database stores customer data accessible from the application.
